name: Kamaliya Meta Fields Builder
author: Kamlesh Kamaliya

sections.description:
Kamaliya Meta Fields Builder is the ultimate tool for developers and site builders to create custom fields and meta boxes effortlessly. Fully integrated with Gutenberg block editor and classic post screens.

Features:
* Drag and drop field ordering.
* Native Gutenberg support with real-time UI.
* Repeater, Sub-Repeater, and Nested Repeater fields support.
* Modern UX Validation with inline error logging.
* No complex coding required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/kamaliya-meta-fields-builder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Kamaliya Meta” menu to start building fields!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, it is completely free and open source.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Major Overhaul: Upgraded directly to v2.0.0 due to extensive structure and architectural updates.
  • Feature: Added smart front-end form submission interception ensuring mandatory validation for Fields and Slugs.
  • Feature: Added modern inline Admin Notification Banners for missing labels instead of outdated browser popups.
  • Feature: Enhanced Location Logic to support multiple active Gutenberg blocks under the same rule group seamlessly.
  • Feature: Embedded a quick and clean “Move to Trash” core function alongside the main action layout.
  • UI/UX Fix: Resolved inline-flex CSS constraints to ensure icons and slugs line up perfectly on any display scale.
  • UI/UX Fix: Implemented live keyboard listeners to clear error logs and color borders instantly as the user types.
  • Stability: Form data now maps perfectly with native WP publish states, preventing unexpected fallback to drafts on save.

1.4.8

  • Compatibility: Fully tested and verified to work flawlessly with WordPress 7.0.
  • Enhancement: Upgraded Gutenberg block registration to API Version 3 for improved Site Editor and iframe rendering compatibility.

1.4.7

  • Security Enhancement: Fixed path traversal (LFI) issue in block rendering.
  • Security Enhancement: Added sanitization for JSON imports.
  • Feature: Added ACF-style smart helper function (kmfb_get_field) with auto JSON decoding.
  • Feature: Added “Clone” button to duplicate fields in Backend Builder and Frontend Repeater.
  • Fix: Gutenberg block repeater now properly loads default values on initialization.

1.4.6

  • Initial Public Release.
  • Added Drag and Drop sorting.
  • Added Native Gutenberg Modal UI.
